APPROVE
The extracted helpers (`BoundLiteral`, `IsRejectedKeyValue`, `IsLookupKeyNotKeyMaterial`, `ClassifyCryptoKey`) keep every check in the same order with the same short-circuiting, and moving the nested ternaries, `||`/`&&` chains and the lookup-key `if` out of the method should bring it well under 15; the source isn't on this machine, though, so I couldn't build it to confirm that `name` is a `Match` and `lines` is a `string[]`, as the new signatures assume.
